manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.bo:
Bob-ombs follow you and pick fights with monsters, going off the moment one hits back. Hitting one yourself only lights its fuse.

One will ride on your head too. Sneak and use one with an empty hand to pick it back up.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.pa: Parabuzzies hover more than they fall, and hunt monsters. Hurt one and it turns on you. A fish may tame one, and any food heals a tame one.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.eight_bit.pe:
Use a tame parabuzzy and it climbs onto your head. There it slowly heals, and you drift down as gently as it does and take no fall damage.

Sneak on the ground to put it down. The red and spiked ones are tougher, and only the blue ones drop a shell.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.ice_pixie.fi:
Nothing hurts an ice pixie unless you are holding a torch or flint and steel when you hit it.

Torches placed nearby burn it too, the more the faster, and it runs from them.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.ice_pixie.in: Ice pixies live in snowy places and come out by day as well as by night. They throw ice at any player they see, and move faster on ice and snow.
manual.assortedmobs.chapter.treasure_mob: Now and then a chest walks off on its own. It carries whatever it found, anything from bread to diamonds, and drops all of it if it dies.

A wild one keeps away from players, but gold nuggets lure it in. Feed it nuggets and it may decide to stay.

A tame one follows you and sits when told to. Sneak and use it to open it as a chest.
manual.assortedmobs.description: The ice pixie, the treasure mob, and the two 8-bit creatures: where to find them and what to do with them.
